tagline: Leading manufacturer of water heating and treatment solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The North America segment represents 78% of total sales, serving as the primary driver of growth and profitability, supported by key regulatory dynamics (DOE energy efficiency standards) and significant price increases offsetting cost pressures.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of profit after cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin improves from 38.1% in 2024 to 38.8% in 2025, driven by price increases and a better contribution from commercial products.
kpis.signal: Improvement due to pricing and a more profitable product mix.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Calculated as pre-tax income (715.1M) / sales (3,830.2M), operating margin is stable at approximately 18.7% in 2025 versus 18.4% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Slight improvement despite higher overhead expenses.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total annual sales of the company.
kpis.description: Revenue increases from $3,818.1M in 2024 to $3,830.2M in 2025, a 0.3% rise, driven by price increases, commercial volumes, and the Pureit acquisition.
kpis.signal: Very modest growth, driven by pricing and acquisitions.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on new equipment or production capacity.
kpis.description: The company maintains capital expenditures at approximately $120M to support commercial capacity and comply with DOE energy efficiency regulations for commercial water heaters effective October 2026.
kpis.signal: Stable Capex to support DOE regulatory compliance.

kpis.name: North America Sales
kpis.explanation: Sales generated in the North America region.
kpis.description: North America sales represent 78% of total sales, increasing 1.2% in 2025 ($2,984.2M vs $2,950.1M in 2024), driven by commercial boilers and water heaters.
kpis.signal: Growth supported by commercial products and price increases.

kpis.name: China Sales (third-party)
kpis.explanation: Sales in China to external customers (excluding intercompany sales).
kpis.description: China sales decline by 12% in local currency in 2025, impacted by weak consumer demand and the discontinuation of government subsidy programs in the second half of the year.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in China in local currency due to weak demand and subsidy removal.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €3.14 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.19 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.72 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.196 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years using yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 35.8% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Pureit Contribution
kpis.explanation: Sales generated from the Pureit acquisition since November 2024.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Pureit from Unilever in November 2024 for $125M contributed $54M in sales in 2025 within the Rest of World segment, doubling market penetration in South Asia with a broad range of residential water purification solutions.
kpis.signal: Strategic acquisition doubling South Asia market penetration.

kpis.name: Commercial Water Heater Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth in sales of water heaters for commercial applications.
kpis.description: Commercial water heater volumes increased by approximately 5% in 2025, ahead of the new DOE energy efficiency regulations effective October 2026. Growth is estimated at 3% to 5% in 2026 due to the pull-forward effect of products that will be phased out by the regulatory change.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by pull-forward demand ahead of DOE regulation.

risks.title: Global economic deterioration and demand weakness
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked first in the section (strong positioning), intense language 'could materially adversely affect', stable trend but deteriorating macro context (recession, inflation), macro category heavily weighted for cyclical sector.

risks.title: Tariffs and trade restrictions
risks.score_rationale: Major risk in economic section, highly intense language 'could significantly increase the prices' and 'could have a material adverse effect', increasing trend (new administration, announced tariffs), direct impact on critical raw material costs.

risks.title: Customer concentration and commercial dependency
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified risk with key figure (41% of sales to 5 customers), language 'could have a material adverse effect', stable but structural trend, high credit weighting due to customer dependency.

risks.title: Geographic exposure to China and uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Specific risk with quantified data (18% of sales, 4,200 employees, $140M in cash), language 'could materially and adversely affect', increasing trend (12% decline in 2025, strategic review announced), geopolitics heavily weighted.

risks.title: Commodity price volatility and supplier concentration
risks.score_rationale: Major operational risk with concrete examples (steel, freight inflation), language 'could lead to lower operating earnings' and 'material adverse effect', increasing trend (recent inflation, potential tariffs), strong industrial weighting.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and protection of sensitive data
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified risk with operational details (customer data, employee data, third-party systems), language 'could adversely affect our business and reputation', stable trend but rising risks (AI, remote work), cybersecurity very heavily weighted.

risks.title: Technological change and consumer preferences
risks.score_rationale: Major strategic risk with explicit trends (decarbonization, electrification, e-commerce), language 'could materially and adversely affect', increasing trend (ongoing energy transition), strong technology weighting.

risks.title: Extraordinary events and natural disasters
risks.score_rationale: Operational risk with concrete exposure (2 plants in flood-prone areas, seismic/hurricane zones), language 'could significantly disrupt production' and 'materially and adversely affect', stable trend but worsened by climate change, moderate environmental weighting.

ai_positioning.summary: The company AOS has no significant mentions of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from the 10-K/20-F filing.
